revision: Five-card menu with actual user-supplied creature GLB
assessmentType: Subjective visual assessment of actual-model integration in the current user-authorized five-card composition. Not an objective pixel-match score.

rubric.notes: The same five original environment portraits remain unchanged for this model-integration revision. Distinct waterfall, manor, submerged garden, basalt coast and floating-monument motifs retain cohesive atmospheric depth.
The approved five-card row remains at left edges 139, 340, 541, 742, 943; top 211; width 197; height 298; gap 4 at 1280x720. Resume is selected initially. The real creature renders behind every card.

Card scrims and text shadows preserve the prior readability improvements. Supporting copy remains very small at 1280px, consistent with the reference scale. Actual model rendering does not obscure menu labels.

The supplied animated GLB is now visible rather than the illustrated stand-in. Crown, eye, orbital rings, outer arm, hands and robe establish the intended silhouette behind the cards. Lowering the model slightly resolves the initial top-edge crown clipping. Some outer hand and lower robe cropping remains; pose and geometry differences from the first illustration are intentional features of the supplied asset.

Corrected exposure preserves crown and robe detail and fits the model into the warm gold/teal atmosphere. Model hair and skin still read more mint and diffusely lit than the darker illustrated reference; some material appearance differences belong to the supplied asset.

Teal cores and soft halos surround the actual model without masking the cards. Named Idle animation and motion-preference behavior are supported by artifacts/model-verification.json; still-image visual review does not independently measure animation quality.

iterationHistory.findings: Root identified overexposure and corrected the lighting before independent numerical review.
Exposure, placement, menu readability and behind-card layering were acceptable. Critic requested approximately 6-10px extra clearance for the tallest crown tip.
Crown lowered and final production renders inspected at 1280x720 and 1920x1080. Current real-model integration meets the subjective 9/10 target.

model.fallback: Illustration retained for unavailable or unsupported model rendering
